title: Protest in Užice supporting mother seeking investigation into daughter's death
seoTitle: Užice protest for medical death inquiry

tea.why: A mother held a nine-day hunger strike to demand answers regarding the 2023 death of her pregnant daughter at the Užice hospital.
tea.want: The protesters demand a new independent forensic expert analysis and accountability for alleged evidence manipulation.
tea.changed: Nov 15: The mother ended her hunger strike and supporters gathered at the prosecutor's office to demand a new investigation.

summary: A group of residents in Užice gathered outside the local prosecutor's office to support a mother who had been on a nine-day hunger strike. The mother was protesting the 2023 death of her 25-year-old daughter, who died while six months pregnant at the Užice hospital. The mother ended her hunger strike on November 15, 2026, stating she would continue her pursuit of justice through other means. The protesters are calling for a new, independent forensic examination, citing discrepancies in official medical reports that listed different causes of death. They also allege that critical evidence, including autopsy molds, was mishandled. The protest was organised following a call from students to support the mother's ongoing efforts to hold the hospital and relevant institutions accountable for the death.
response: No official response reported in the sources.

deaths.text: The protest concerns the 2023 death of a 25-year-old pregnant woman at the Užice hospital.

updates.text: The mother began a hunger strike in front of the city hall to demand answers regarding her daughter's death.
The mother ended her hunger strike, and a support gathering was held outside the prosecutor's office.
